capabilities: Writes tags, nested tags and ratings into JPEG, PNG, TIFF and WebP metadata via ExifTool
Browses thumbnails with tag and folder trees, filters and saved filter sets
Applies basic edits: exposure, color, levels, crop, rotate and straighten
Exports photos selected by tag, rating, folder or filter with resize and format options
Maintains a rebuildable local index with metadata undo and edit backups
extras: Desktop beta; helpers (Python, ExifTool) must be installed separately and are never downloaded by the plugin; embedded-write backups can take substantial disk space; concurrent writing from multiple machines or Obsidian instances is unsupported; renamed from Photo Workspace in 0.0.4 and dropped the former digiKam database connection in 0.0.3.
motivation: Built on Obsidian's local-file-first philosophy so the work of organizing a photo collection stays with the photos instead of being locked in one program's database.
problem: Obsidian has no way to organize a local photo library with tags and ratings that stay portable inside the image files rather than in a proprietary database.
summary: Local photo library plugin that writes tags, nested tags and ratings into image metadata, with browsing, basic editing and filtered export.
